python3 tools/pin-disposition.py --manifest .ufo/evidence/round-13/pin-manifest.json --root /tmp/tameshi-r18w2-CR46-Pravyu/fleet > /tmp/tameshi-r18w2-CR46-Pravyu/fx/pin.json; echo "pin_disposition_exit=$?"; python3 -c "
import json,subprocess,hashlib,os
d=json.load(open(\"/tmp/tameshi-r18w2-CR46-Pravyu/fx/pin.json\"))
print(\"top_keys=\",sorted(d))
legs=d.get(\"legs\") or d.get(\"rows\")
print(\"n_legs=\",len(legs), \"unavailable_count=\", json.dumps(d.get(\"counts\") or d.get(\"summary\")))
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(\"GIT_\")}
for L in legs:
    h=L[\"head\"]
    print(\"LEG\",L[\"leg\"],\"repo=\",L[\"repo\"],\"path=\",L[\"path\"],\"head=\",json.dumps(h,sort_keys=True), \"content_status=\",L.get(\"content_status\"))
    repo=os.path.join(\"/tmp/tameshi-r18w2-CR46-Pravyu/fleet\",L[\"repo\"])
    g=lambda *a: subprocess.run([\"git\",\"-C\",repo]+list(a),capture_output=True,env=env)
    raw_head=g(\"rev-parse\",\"HEAD\").stdout.decode().strip()
    sym=g(\"symbolic-ref\",\"-q\",\"HEAD\")
    br=h.get(\"branch\")
    tip=g(\"rev-parse\",\"refs/heads/%s\"%br).stdout.decode().strip() if br else None
    blob=g(\"cat-file\",\"blob\",\"refs/heads/%s:%s\"%(br,L[\"path\"])) if br else None
    bsha=hashlib.sha256(blob.stdout).hexdigest() if blob is not None and blob.returncode==0 else None
    print(\"   CHECK raw_HEAD=%s symref_rc=%d tip=%s head_differs_recomputed=%s tool_head_differs=%s tip_blob_sha=%s tool_blob_sha=%s match=%s\"%(raw_head, sym.returncode, tip, (raw_head!=tip) if tip else None, h.get(\"head_differs_from_branch\"), bsha, h.get(\"blob_sha256\"), bsha==h.get(\"blob_sha256\")))
"
